title: Member photos are kept inside the main gym database with no cap per gym, so they eat the free 500 MB limit that every gym shares
what: Each photo taken on Add member is saved as a picture of up to 100 KB (about 60 KB aimed) inside the same database that holds every gym's members and receipts. There is no limit on how many photos one gym keeps, and photos of deleted members stay behind. About 8,000 photos across all gyms would fill the free 500 MB on their own. When the database is full, saving members and payments can stop for every gym at once. Every screen that shows faces also pulls the photos through the database, which uses the free download traffic.
expected: Photos live somewhere whose size does not risk the main database (or each gym has a photo cap), old photos are cleared, and MettleUp sees how much space photos take before the limit.
who: all gyms, owners and front desk
how_often: grows with every photo; risk once many gyms use photos
fix_line: Track photo space in HQ, set a per-gym photo cap, clear photos of removed members, and plan a move to file storage before the limit
